<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">

    <key>Label</key><string>com.granola-share.server</string>

services.systemd:
[Unit]
Description=granola-share server

[Service]
ExecStart="/opt/Study Stash/studystash" --home /home/student/.granola-share run
Environment=GRANOLA_SHARE_SERVICE=1
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
services.systemd_odd:
[Unit]
Description=granola-share client

[Service]
ExecStart="/opt/a&b <c>/studystash" --home "/home/student/x & y" client run
Environment=GRANOLA_SHARE_SERVICE=1
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

firewall.script: Remove-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Study Stash library' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Study Stash library' -Description 'Lets your laptop reach your Study Stash library. Added by granola-share setup.' -Direction Inbound -Action Allow -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 8790 -RemoteAddress 100.64.0.0/10,LocalSubnet -Profile Any | Out-Null; $py = @('C:\Program Files\Study Stash\studystash.exe','C:\Users\it''s me\studystash.exe'); Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter | Where-Object { $py -contains $_.Program } | Get-NetFirewallRule | Where-Object { $_.Direction -eq 'Inbound' -and $_.Action -eq 'Block' } | Remove-NetFirewallRule
